chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: AI Core Issue #1 and Source PR #3 HEAD 75778b66; live readback https://github.com/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1#issuecomment-6222440936 verified clean PR3 worktree, Gate running, four backends stopped, private bus exists. Need Docker Compose ownership and image before reversible UDS cutover.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
w=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = 75778b66afcd397da5225466aadcc20fcd0df991
report="AI_CORE_UDS_DOCKER_CONTRACT
SOURCE_EXACT=YES"
for n in ai-core-model-gate ai-coder ai-qwen3 ai-granite ai-ministral; do
 v=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Name}} project={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}} svc={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}} running={{.State.Running}} cgroup={{.HostConfig.CgroupParent}} cpu={{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}} mem={{.HostConfig.Memory}} binds={{json .HostConfig.PortBindings}} mounts={{range .Mounts}}{{.Destination}};{{end}}' "$n" 2>/dev/null || true)
 report="$report
$n: ${v:-MISSING}"
done
images=$(docker image ls --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}} {{.ID}}' | grep -E '(ai-core-model-gate|ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp)' | head -12 || true)
report="$report
IMAGES:
$images"
printf '%s\n' "$report"
if gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f "body=$report" --jq .html_url; then echo 'DOCKER_CONTRACT_PUBLISHED=YES'; else echo 'DOCKER_CONTRACT_PUBLISHED=NO'; fi
